SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 60;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
HAVING SUM(yt) > 0
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 260 and 280
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC;
